subject.title: Adopt the core durable ingress drain on the remaining channels (WhatsApp, Discord, Slack, Signal, iMessage)

question: Which remaining channels should be included in this issue’s next wave, and which should remain optional because they already have an adequate durable cursor or replay store?
rationale: The shared seam exists, but the current discussion expands the original scope and identifies channel-specific delivery contracts that require an explicit reliability/product boundary rather than a blanket migration.

options.title: Proceed with named remaining channels
options.body: Prioritize WhatsApp once credentials are restored, then review Discord and iMessage as separate adapter PRs with channel-specific proof.

options.title: Split adequately durable channels out
options.body: Keep this issue focused on channels with demonstrated receive-to-adoption loss and track any uniformity-only migrations separately.

options.title: Adopt the full fleet audit
options.body: Expand the issue to all channels in the audit, accepting a larger multi-wave reliability program.

recommendation.title: Proceed with named remaining channels
recommendation.body: Prioritize WhatsApp once credentials are restored, then review Discord and iMessage as separate adapter PRs with channel-specific proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and have authored the active migration plan and the first merged adapter waves.
